# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and the shared rules in `.agents/rules/` (`clean-code`, `context-mode`).

- Project Agent Skills (optional): `.agents/skills/`
- Superpowers plugin (vendored): `.agents/plugins/superpowers/` — skills under `skills/`; use `using-superpowers` and other matching skills before acting
- Install Superpowers in your harness per `README.md` § Superpowers so session bootstrap loads skills
